newsitem.title: USA: Starrett sold to Jacob Frydman for $75 million.
newsitem.headline: Starrett sold to Jacob Frydman for $75 million.

text.p: Starrett Corp., a real estate firm, said Thursday it will be acquired by the real estate merchant bank Frydman & Co. in a stock transaction worth $75 million.
Under the deal, Frydman will pay $12.25 per share in cash for Starrett's 6.2 million shares.
Frydman is a real estate merchant bank that handles property in Manhattan and the surrounding area. Starrett builds and sells residential and office properties.
Starrett said the stockholders who control 52 percent of its shares have agreed to vote in favour of the sale.
Its stock was up 31 cents at $10.75 on the American Stock Exchange.
